The weighted cloud reliability calculator successfully passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a functional core logic for risk assessment.
The execution achieved a 1.000 mean reward across 1 trial with zero exceptions recorded. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' with a duration of 0.436s. While the current implementation is stable, future iterations should re-check edge cases in weighting logic to ensure robustness beyond the initial test suite.
